      ∀ σ : FactorType, (∀ τ' : FactorType, σ ≠ scaleType δ τ') →
        (lawCoeff (lawDescend δ L) σ).eval q = 0

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_flatMap
statement:

    (lawCoeff (L ++ M) σ).eval q = (lawCoeff L σ).eval q + (lawCoeff M σ).eval q ∧
      (lawCoeff ([] : Law) σ).eval q = 0 ∧
      (lawCoeff (xs.flatMap f) σ).eval q = (xs.map fun x ↦ (lawCoeff (f x) σ).eval q).sum

    (lawCoeff (lawMul L M) σ).eval q = ∑ τ ∈ (L.map Prod.fst).toFinset,
      (if τ ≤ σ then (lawCoeff L τ).eval q * (lawCoeff M (σ - τ)).eval q else 0)

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_nonneg_closure
statement:
theorem law_coeff_nonneg_closure (q : ℚ) :
    (∀ (x : Expr) (L : Law), 0 ≤ x.eval q → (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff L σ).eval q) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawScale x L) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ L M : Law, (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff L σ).eval q) →
      (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff M σ).eval q) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawMul L M) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ Ls : List Law, (∀ L ∈ Ls, (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff L σ).eval q)) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawProd Ls) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ (α : Type) (xs : List α) (f : α → Law),
      (∀ x ∈ xs, ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (f x) σ).eval q) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (xs.flatMap f) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ (δ : ℕ), 0 < δ → ∀ L : Law, (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff L σ).eval (q ^ δ)) →
      ∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawDescend δ L) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ (a f : ℕ) (σ : FactorType), 0 ≤ (lawCoeff (lawAtom a f) σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ σ : FactorType, 0 ≤ (lawCoeff lawOne σ).eval q) ∧
    (∀ σ : FactorType, (lawCoeff ([] : Law) σ).eval q = 0)

name: SurfaceBlowup.law_coeff_prod_descend

      ∑ τ ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun j : Fin Ls.length ↦ ((Ls.get j).2.map Prod.fst).toFinset),
        (if σ = ∑ j, scaleType (Ls.get j).1 (τ j) then

            ⟨r - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_le h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2⟩)).val else 0) ∧

statement:
theorem invariant_orbit_factors (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [IsDiscreteValuationRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot Φ)]
    (ι : BaseField O →+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    (τ : ℕ → (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ) ≃+* BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))
    (hτ : ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : AdjoinRoot Φ), τ i
      (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) x) = algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ)
      (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)) (frobeniusIter O Φ i x))
    (hτι : ∀ (i : ℕ) (y : BaseField O), τ i (ι y) = ι y)
    (hτ0 : τ 0 = RingEquiv.refl (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))
    (hrec : ∀ i : ℕ, τ (i+1) = (τ i).trans (τ 1))
    (hτδ : ∀ z : BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ), τ Φ.natDegree z = z)
    (hfix : ∀ z : BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ), τ 1 z = z → ∃ y : BaseField O, ι y = z)
    (hinj : Function.Injective ι) (F : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot Φ))
    (gs : List (Polynomial (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) (hgs : ∀ g ∈ gs, g.Monic ∧ Irreducible g)
    (hd : gs.Pairwise (fun g h => g ≠ h))
    (hprod : F.map (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ))) = gs.prod)
    (hcop : ∀ i j : Fin Φ.natDegree, i ≠ j → IsCoprime
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree => (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
          (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) i)
      ((fun i : Fin Φ.natDegree => (F.map (frobeniusIter O Φ i).toRingHom).map
          (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))) j)) :
    ∃ H : Fin gs.length → Polynomial (BaseField O), (∀ a, (H a).Monic ∧ Irreducible (H a)) ∧
      Function.Injective H ∧
      (∀ a, (H a).map ι = ∏ i : Fin Φ.natDegree, (gs.get a).map (τ i).toRingHom) ∧
      (∀ a, (H a).natDegree = Φ.natDegree * (gs.get a).natDegree) ∧ (∏ a, H a).map ι =
      (conjugateProduct O Φ F).map (algebraMap (AdjoinRoot Φ) (BaseField (AdjoinRoot Φ)))

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_allowedPatterns_crossing

theorem sum_allowedPatterns_crossing (a b c h : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hh : 0 < h) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Pattern (State.crossing a b c h).degree → Coef) :
    ∑ P ∈ allowedPatterns (State.crossing a b c h), F P.d.val P.rt.val P.rx.val P.other =
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min c h), ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
      (if ((0 < rt ↔ d < c) ∧ (0 < rx ↔ d < h) ∧ rt + rx ≤ d) then
        ∑ m ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Pattern (State.crossing a b c h).degree)).filter
          (fun m ↦ patternWeight m = d - rt - rx), F d rt rx m
      else 0)

name: SurfaceBlowup.sum_allowedPatterns_reindex
statement:
theorem sum_allowedPatterns_reindex (s : State) (D : ℕ) (hD : D ≤ s.degree)
    (Q : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [∀ d rt rx, Decidable (Q d rt rx)]
    (hmem : ∀ P, P ∈ allowedPatterns s ↔ 0 < P.d.val ∧
      P.rt.val + P.rx.val + patternWeight P.other = P.d.val ∧ P.d.val ≤ D ∧
      Q P.d.val P.rt.val P.rx.val)
    (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Pattern s.degree → Coef) :
    ∑ P ∈ allowedPatterns s, F P.d.val P.rt.val P.rx.val P.other =
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 D, ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
      (if Q d rt rx ∧ rt + rx ≤ d then
        ∑ m ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Pattern s.degree)).filter
          (fun m ↦ patternWeight m = d - rt - rx), F d rt rx m
      else 0)

      ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), (if ((0 < r ↔ d < n) ∧ r ≤ d) then
        ∑ m ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Pattern (State.single a n).degree)).filter
          (fun m ↦ patternWeight m = d - r), F d r m else 0)

    ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (c + 1), ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (c + 1), ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (c + 1),
        (if rx + m + rt ≤ K then G rx m rt else 0) = ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (c + 1),
        ∑ rt ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), ∑ rx ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
        (if (rt + rx ≤ d ∧ d ≤ K) then G rx (d - rt - rx) rt else 0)

        (lawProd ((children (State.single a n) P).map fun z ↦ lawDescend z.1 (stateLaw z.2)))) =

        scalar ((divisorCount 0 P.other).rational * (divisorProbability (State.single a n)
        P.d.val).rational) * ((if P.rt.val = 0 then 1 else lawCoef
        (stateLaw (State.crossing a a P.rt.val (n - P.d.val)))) *
        ∏ ij : Fin (State.single a n).degree × Fin (State.single a n).degree,

statement:
theorem block_translation (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) (r : ℕ) :
    Set.BijOn (translateBlock O Φ r) (blockCell O Φ r) (zeroCell O Φ r) ∧
      (∀ (L : ℕ) (b b' : Fin r → AdjoinRoot Φ), (∀ j, b j - b' j ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L) ↔ ∀ j,
        translateBlock O Φ r b j - translateBlock O Φ r b' j ∈ (baseIdeal O Φ) ^ L)

statement:
theorem conjugate_roots_distinct (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O] [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField O)]
    (Φ : Polynomial O) (hΦ : IsUnramifiedLift O Φ) :
    (∀ c : O, residueEmbed O Φ (IsLocalRing.residue O c) = baseReduce O Φ
        (algebraMap O (AdjoinRoot Φ) c)) ∧ Function.Injective (residueEmbed O Φ) ∧
      (∀ i : ℕ, ((residuePoly O Φ).map (residueEmbed O Φ)).IsRoot (rootBar O Φ ^ residueCard O ^ i))
      ∧ (∀ i j : ℕ, i < Φ.natDegree → j < Φ.natDegree → rootBar O Φ ^ residueCard O ^ i =
        rootBar O Φ ^ residueCard O ^ j → i = j) ∧ (residuePoly O Φ).map (residueEmbed O Φ) = ∏ i :
      Fin Φ.natDegree, conjugateFactor O Φ i ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin Φ.natDegree, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (conjugateFactor O Φ i) (conjugateFactor O Φ j))

theorem factor_product_congruence_iff (O : Type) [CommRing O] [IsDomain O]

    (hc : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) (L : ℕ) (a a' : ∀ i, Fin (g i).natDegree → O)
    (ha : a ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i)))
    (ha' : a' ∈ Set.pi Set.univ (fun i => residueCell O (g i).natDegree (g i))) :
    (∀ j, factorProduct (fun i => (g i).natDegree) a j - factorProduct
        (fun i => (g i).natDegree) a' j ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) ^ L) ↔ ∀ i j,

statement:
theorem principal_residue_ideal_count (k : Type) [Field k] [Finite k] (a b N : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (P : TwoSeries k → Prop) (Q : SpecialFiber k a b → Prop)
    (hQ : ∀ F, Q (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ F) ↔ P F) (hunit : ∀ U F, IsUnit U → P F → P (U * F))
    (hlen : ∀ F, P F → Module.length (TwoSeries k)
      (TwoSeries k ⧸ (monomialIdeal k a b ⊔ Ideal.span {F})) = N)
    (hcard : ∀ F, P F →
      Nat.card (TwoSeries k ⧸ (monomialIdeal k a b ⊔ Ideal.span {F})) = Nat.card k ^ N)
    (A B : Finset (truncIndex a b (N + 1))) (hAB : Disjoint A B) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hcrit : ∀ F, P F ↔ (∀ s ∈ A, truncCoeffs k a b (N + 1) F s = 0) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ B, truncCoeffs k a b (N + 1) F s ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card {I : Ideal (SpecialFiber k a b) // ∃ f, I = Ideal.span {f} ∧ Q f} *
        ((Nat.card k - 1) * Nat.card k ^ (A.card + B.card - 1)) =
      (Nat.card k - 1) ^ B.card * Nat.card k ^ N
